scenario: `no X` on a `logical` schema without `within` checks for complete absence of a live derived fact per LFAC.3.4. A `logical` fact either exists or doesn't at any instant; `within` is only meaningful on `ttl` (event) facts. Pin: a rule matching `no Alert` (a logical schema, no `within`) after a `ttl` trigger compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` observes neither the absence check nor the lowering.
rules_ds:
schema Alert scope logical:
    entity_id: String key

schema Trigger scope ttl 1_min:
    v: Int

rule when_quiet:
    Trigger
    no Alert
->
    log info "no alerts active"
